notes.title: Update Notes – September 13, 2025
notes.notes:
[Patch Notes]

1. Added quest save feature
2. Fixed an issue where players could pass through walls after clearing the boss dungeon
3. Added dialogue skip feature
4. Fixed Japanese font error on the Skip button

notes.title: Update Notes – August 6, 2025
notes.notes:
\[Patch Notes]

1. Default language changed from Korean to English
2. Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in walls when respawning in certain areas
3. Fixed a bug where the Black Panther boss's dialogue would not appear
4. Updated save data path to a safer location
